summary: Minor or disabled children, a disabled spouse and disabled parents are guaranteed two thirds of their intestate share. Belarus has no trust law and is not party to the Hague Trusts Convention. Choice of foreign law is not confirmed.
reserved_share: Minor or disabled children, disabled spouse and parents, and dependants: not less than 2/3 of the intestate share; Civil Code art. 1063.
foreign_law_note: Civil Code private international law rules apply the law of the deceased's last domicile; immovables follow the law of their location. A free choice of national law was not confirmed.
trust_note: Only trust management of property (a contract) exists, not a trust. Foundations are non-commercial entities with restricted purposes.
open_questions: Article 1063 fraction and the current conflict-of-law articles were not checked in the official text.
